layout_summary: A tall two-column poster on pure white: a red stiletto bleeding into a Biscoff jar occupies the left third and runs from the top-left corner down to 82% height, while a centred three-line movie-title lockup sits in the right half between 29% and 55%. A single red one-line kicker in heavy sans runs full-width across the bottom at 95%.

alignment_axes: All three headline lines ('THE', 'DEVIL'/'EATS', 'BISCOFF') are centred on a shared vertical axis at x=68%
'DEVIL' and 'BISCOFF' share an identical left edge at x=47.5% and right edge at x=89.5% — the two display lines are optically width-matched
The shoe-to-jar drip column and the jar body share a vertical centre at x=29%
Bottom kicker is centred on the canvas centre axis at x=50%, independent of the headline axis
Headline block bottom (55%) and jar top-of-lid (~66%) leave an unoccupied horizontal band shared across both columns
whitespace: Entire right column above y=29% is empty white (x 45-100%, y 0-29%) — roughly 16% of canvas height
Full-width empty band between the jar base (y=82%) and the kicker cap-top (y=94%) — a 12% breathing gap
Empty white block right of the jar and below the headline (x 45-100%, y 56-92%) — the largest single void, about 36% height
Left edge is deliberately bled: the shoe is cropped off-canvas at x=0, so there is no left margin
~5.5% clear gap between the headline's right edge (89.5%) and the right canvas edge

scene.subject: A glossy scarlet patent-leather stiletto court shoe, angled toe-up to the upper right, whose slim heel melts and stretches downward into three liquid caramel-brown tendrils that pour into the open mouth of a squat glass spread jar; thick caramel spread overflows the rim, coats the lid thread and runs in heavy drips down the jar's side to pool at its base. The jar is wrapped in a red wraparound label with a mustard-yellow oval band and a biscuit-and-spoon illustration.
scene.composition: Shoe enters from the top-left corner and is cropped by the left canvas edge, filling the diagonal from (0,50%) to (36%,10%); the heel tapers to a drip column centred at x=29% that connects into the jar below; the jar sits bottom-left, upright, occupying x 15-41%, y 65-82%, with a faint contact shadow. Together they form one continuous top-left-to-bottom-centre diagonal that leaves the right half empty for type.
scene.camera: Straight-on, near eye-level product view with a slight high angle on the jar lid showing a sliver of the opening; long-lens feel with no perspective distortion, everything in sharp focus front to back, no depth-of-field falloff.
scene.lighting: Soft broad key from the upper left with a bright specular highlight running the length of the shoe's vamp and a second sharp highlight on the heel; a cooler fill from the right separates the jar from the white ground; shadows are extremely soft and almost absent, producing a cut-out-on-white studio look.
negative_space: x 45-100%, y 56-92% (white right of and below the jar)
x 0-100%, y 82-93% (full-width band above the kicker)

elements.text: Don’t be silly Andrea, everybody wants this.

ornaments.description: A thin black devil-tail arrow replacing the upward stroke of the 'I' in DEVIL — a slim curved stem rising above the cap line and terminating in a solid filled arrowhead pointing up-right; drawn in the same black as the type, roughly 1.5x the cap height tall.

Three pointed caramel drip tips hanging from the underside of the melted heel loops, each ending in a small downward spike just above the jar mouth (part of the rendered scene, but reading graphically as a trio of accent marks).

why_it_works: The movie-poster title lockup is instantly recognisable as a parody frame, so the joke lands before a single word is read.
A hard left/right split — rendered object on the left diagonal, centred type on the right — lets both halves stay large and uncrowded on a white field.
Colour is rationed to exactly two: red for the shoe, the accent words and the kicker; black for the two big title lines, which keeps a busy render legible at thumbnail size.
